strings.איזה דבר שאני אוהב נעשה קל יותר?: What thing I enjoy became easier?
strings.אין הבטחה שהקושי לא יחזור ואין צורך לבדו: There is no promise that difficulty will not return and no need for constant checking. Functional, health or environmental changes need suitable assessment. Do not independently restart tasks or change medication based on the sheet.
strings.אין להחיל את המסלול על קבוצות גיל אחרות: Do not apply this pathway to other age groups without separate review.
strings.אין שמירה אוטומטית ואין שליחה לרשת. השתמ: Nothing is saved automatically or sent over the network. Use fictional information for review. If an answer does not fit, shorten it or save the complete answers as text and move them to a continuation page. Check print preview.
strings.בדקו תפקוד וקשר לאורך זמן לפי התוכנית המ: Review functioning and relationships over time under the agreed plan. Form count does not determine treatment ending; new needs justify reassessment.
strings.בחרו בדף לאחר הערכה מקצועית ובהסכמה. אפש: Choose this sheet following professional assessment and with consent. The person may skip questions, answer aloud, or choose another tool. This is proposed original material for review; it provides no score, diagnosis, or promise of an outcome.
strings.גילי 6–7: מה נשמר ומי יעזור בהמשך: Ages 6–7: what remains and who will help next
strings.דברים שלמדתי ועזרה להמשך: Things I learned and help for next steps
strings.דברים שלמדתי ועזרה להמשך | Mindful Path: Things I learned and help for next steps | Mindful Path
strings.דוגמה בדויה: רותי אומרת שהיא שוב משחקת ע: Fictional example: Ruthie says she plays with a friend again. Her father describes a new morning-routine change. The therapist explores and updates contact arrangements without portraying difficulty as failure.
strings.דף P משותף לילד ולמלווה: שתי שאלות לקול: The P sheet is shared: two questions for the child's voice and three for supporter observations. Use only as agreed with the therapist, without child-alone exposure homework, abrupt response changes or punishment. Daily records and thought counts are unnecessary.
strings.המטפל או המלווה מקריא שאלה אחת. הילד יכו: The therapist or support person reads one question. The child may use a few words, point or skip. Adults may write the child's words but not answer for them. Professional terms and descriptions of every thought are not required.

strings.הקישורים הבאים שימשו לרקע בלבד. השאלות ו: The following links were used for background only. Questions and adaptations were written afresh for the expansion plan; no questionnaire, scale, or protocol was copied. Adult sources do not validate the child versions. This material makes no claim about session count or treatment effectiveness.
strings.השתמשו בדוגמה ממשחק, קשר או שגרה. אין לה: Use an example from play, relationships or routine. Do not make the child identify recurrence signs or manage follow-up alone.
strings.טיוטה לסקירה בלבד - לא להפצה | לא כלי אב: Review draft - not for distribution | Not a diagnostic tool
strings.טיוטה לסקירת מנהל. סקירה קלינית ואישור ז: Draft for administrator review. Clinical review and final rights approval are still pending.

strings.ילד ומלווה יחד, לפי סיכום עם המטפל. שתי: Child and support person together, as agreed with the therapist. Two child questions and three supporter questions. Spoken answers are welcome.

strings.יש תשובה שחורגת משטח המילוי. הטופס לא הו: An answer exceeds the writing area. Printing was stopped to prevent silent clipping. Return to the screen, shorten the answer or save the complete answers as text and move them to a continuation page. Your entered text has not been deleted.
strings.לילד: מה היה לך טוב מאז שנפגשנו?: Child: What was good since we met?
strings.לילד: מה תרצה לספר שקשה עכשיו?: Child: What would you like to tell us is hard now?
strings.למלווה: איזה צורך חדש נביא להערכה מקצועי: Support person: What new need will we bring for professional assessment?
strings.למלווה: איזה שינוי בתפקוד משמעותי לילד?: Support person: What functional change matters to the child?
strings.למלווה: מה סוכם על מעקב ודרך פנייה?: Support person: What follow-up and contact arrangements were agreed?
strings.לסכם עם הילד והמלווים מה התאפשר, איזה שי: Summarize with child and supporters what became possible, changes warranting contact and follow-up agreed with the therapist.
strings.לשיחה עם המטפל והמבוגר שמלווה אותי. אפשר: For talking with the therapist and my support adult. I can say a little, point or skip; the adult can write my words.
strings.מה אני רוצה שהמבוגרים יזכרו עליי?: What do I want adults to remember about me?
strings.מה ארצה לשאול בפגישה הבאה?: What would I like to ask next session?
strings.מה למדתי על בקשת עזרה?: What did I learn about asking for help?

strings.מטפל המיומן ב־OCD בגילי 6–7: Therapist skilled in OCD care for ages 6–7
strings.מי יכול לעזור לי אם שוב קשה?: Who can help if it gets hard again?
strings.מיפוי מול מדריך OCD מלא ואישור מקצועי עד: Mapping against a full OCD manual and professional approval remain pending. This is original support material for review, not an approved ERP manual or its replacement.
strings.מסלול OCDYC נפרד מגילי 8 ומעלה. אין להסי: OCDYC is separate from ages 8 and over. Shortening an adult form does not establish suitability. Earlier OCDYC learning may help, but unit 8 does not prescribe a session number.
Ending or changing settings may raise questions. Give a brief explanation and clear contact route without promising unavailable access. Do not turn a sign list into monitoring every thought.
strings.סכמו מה הובן ומה נשאר פתוח. היעזרו ב־SES: Summarize what became clearer and what remains open. Use the existing SES-S01 and SES-S02 for the session framework. There is no need to repeat an assessment or plan already recorded.
strings.סכמו מעקב והפניה לפי הצורך. יש להשלים מי: Agree on follow-up and referral as needed. Complete manual mapping, clinical and rights reviews before changing draft status.
strings.קול הילד בגילי 6–7: The voice of the child aged 6–7
strings.קיימת רשומת סקירה נפרדת לכל גרסה: התאמת: Each version has a separate review record covering age suitability, originality, rights, and fictional filling. Reviewer and date fields remain blank until assigned. File checks or a code merge are not clinical approval. Clinical information stays only in the authorized setting, outside the code repository.
strings.שימו לב לשינוי משמעותי בתפקוד בלי לתשאל: Notice meaningful functional change without repeated questioning. Maintain an agreed contact route and report changed conditions.
